evals.prompt: Feature: a content app adds a personalised home feed. Product layer: 200k DAU today, growth plans a campaign expected to reach 1M DAU within 6 months; users open the feed ~12 times/day; peak factor 3. The team runs a modular monolith on PostgreSQL with Redis already deployed. Write the architecture decision section of contract.md.
evals.expected_output: Writes measurable quality scenarios (feed P95, peak read QPS computed: 1M×12/86400×3 ≈ 417 QPS, availability, cost, modifiability for ranking changes). Compares at least two feasible options (e.g. fan-out-on-read with Redis cache vs precomputed feed tables with async workers) on those scenarios with evidence or labelled estimates. Chooses, records rejected reasons and a revisit trigger, outlines the evolution path and at least one fitness function, and slices tickets along the feed journey.
expectations: Computes a peak QPS figure
Compares at least two architecture options
States rejected alternatives
Names a revisit trigger or evolution stage

rubric.criterion: Measurable scenarios with capacity derived from the product numbers
Two or more feasible options compared on the scenarios; decision with rejected reasons
Evolution path with triggers and at least one fitness function
Reuses existing topology sensibly; avoids premature services
Quality targets not supplied are proposed assumptions, not fabricated approved requirements; planned checks have owners and are not reported as executed.
